content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"q_rev_fy2024\",\"description\":\"Query Microsoft consolidated total revenue for FY2024 (year ended 2024-06-30, USD) as disclosed in the records of both the FY2024 and FY2025 10-Ks; keep each source's citation, unit and period separate and do not sum duplicate disclosures.\",\"kind\":\"query\",\"query\":{\"records\":[{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2023-07-01\",\"end\":\"2024-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"}]}},{\"requirement_id\":\"e_fy2024_10k\",\"description\":\"Original income statement or table block in the FY2024 10-K (period end 2024-06-30) showing total revenue for the year ended June 30, 2024, with unit and period headings.\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-8602d79f703e48c18c2f27c3\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"e_fy2025_10k\",\"description\":\"Original income statement or table block in the FY2025 10-K (period end 2025-06-30) showing the FY2024 comparative total revenue for the year ended June 30, 2024, with unit and period headings.\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\"}]","reason":"Plan numeric query for FY2024 consolidated revenue plus original-table source evidence from each 10-K to compare the two disclosures.","requirement_ids":[]}
